title: FunGraph: Functionality Aware 3D Scene Graphs for Language-Prompted Scene Interaction
summary: A functionality-aware 3D scene graph that represents affordance-relevant object parts for language-prompted scene interaction.

mechanisms.name: Functional-part scene graph
mechanisms.description: Adds functional elements and their relations to an open-vocabulary 3D scene graph so a language request can resolve both the object and the part used for interaction.
mechanisms.limitations: A scene graph can organize candidate evidence but does not by itself verify physical reachability, interaction outcome, or exact-instance authority.
